plots.open_en: Month eleven opens with Maria handing me a strange gift: a small architect hat.
plots.open_zh: 第十一个月以一种庄重的开场开始：Maria 送我一顶小小的建筑师帽。
plots.life_en: "You will still write code," she says, "but now you draw the map first."
plots.life_zh: 她说：“你仍然写代码，但现在要先画地图。”
plots.close_en: The hat is too small and the responsibility is not.
plots.close_zh: 帽子太小，责任不小。

plots.open_en: My first big design doc meets the review board.
plots.open_zh: 我的第一份重要设计文档接受评审会检阅。
plots.life_en: Alternatives considered, consequences honest, reversibility rated in plain words.
plots.life_zh: 备选方案、诚实的后果、用大白话标注的可逆性。
plots.close_en: Writing the doc found two bugs before code did.
plots.close_zh: 写文档先于代码发现了两个缺陷。

plots.open_en: The team debates splitting the monolith.
plots.open_zh: 团队争论要不要拆分单体。
plots.life_en: We choose modular monolith: one house, carefully separated rooms.
plots.life_zh: 我们选择模块化单体：一栋房子，房间精心隔开。
plots.close_en: Walls first; moving out can wait.
plots.close_zh: 先砌墙；搬家可以再等等。

plots.open_en: A friend team split too early and now pays the distributed tax.
plots.open_zh: 一个友队拆分太早，如今按月缴分布式的税。
plots.life_en: Network flakiness, version skew, and three new dashboards of pain.
plots.life_zh: 网络抖动、版本错位，还有三块令人心痛的新看板。
plots.close_en: Their lesson was cheaper than ours would have been.
plots.close_zh: 他们替我们交了便宜的学费。

plots.open_en: We adopt event driven design for the notification flows.
plots.open_zh: 通知流改用事件驱动设计。
plots.life_en: The board posts what happened; subscribers decide what it means.
plots.life_zh: 公告栏只播发发生了什么；订阅者自己决定含义。
plots.close_en: Producers stop caring who is listening, kindly.
plots.close_zh: 生产者礼貌地不再关心谁在听。

plots.open_en: Three messages fail processing every night at the same minute.
plots.open_zh: 每晚同一分钟有三条消息处理失败。
plots.life_en: The dead letter queue becomes an office with a clerk: us.
plots.life_zh: 死信队列变成了一间有办事员的办公室：就是我们。
plots.close_en: Every poison message now leaves with a diagnosis.
plots.close_zh: 每封毒信离开时都带着诊断书。

plots.open_en: The mobile team and we write the API contract first.
plots.open_zh: 移动团队和我们先写接口契约。
plots.life_en: Consumer driven tests let them design the door they will knock on.
plots.life_zh: 消费方驱动的测试让他们设计自己要敲的门。
plots.close_en: Breaking changes now need a town hall, not a pull request.
plots.close_zh: 破坏性变更现在要开镇民大会，而不是偷偷合 PR。

plots.open_en: Old endpoints retire on a published schedule.
plots.open_zh: 旧接口按公示的日程退休。
plots.life_en: Sunset headers count down politely on every response.
plots.life_zh: 日落响应头在每个响应里礼貌倒计时。
plots.close_en: Nobody was surprised; everybody thanked us.
plots.close_zh: 没有人感到意外；所有人都道了谢。

plots.open_en: We rehearse scaling at double the expected peak.
plots.open_zh: 我们彩排两倍预期峰值的扩容。
plots.life_en: The stateless services stretch; the stateful ones negotiate.
plots.life_zh: 无状态服务伸展开；有状态的服务开始谈判。
plots.close_en: The capacity doc now has numbers instead of vibes.
plots.close_zh: 容量文档里终于有数字而不是气氛。

plots.open_en: Regional rules arrive: certain data must stay in country.
plots.open_zh: 区域法规到了：某些数据必须留在境内。
plots.life_en: We route by residency and design the borders into the diagram.
plots.life_zh: 我们按驻留路由，把边界画进了架构图。
plots.close_en: Compliance shaped the architecture, and it looks better now.
plots.close_zh: 合规塑造了架构，而且它因此更好看了。

plots.open_en: The architecture debt register opens with honest interest rates.
plots.open_zh: 架构债登记簿开张，利率写得很诚实。
plots.life_en: We pay two debts per quarter, picked by pain times frequency.
plots.life_zh: 每季度还两笔债，按痛感乘频率挑选。
plots.close_en: Debt repaid on schedule costs least.
plots.close_zh: 按时还债成本最低。

plots.open_en: The legacy reporting module gets strangled slowly.
plots.open_zh: 遗留报表模块开始被慢慢绞杀。
plots.life_en: New routes grow around it, one endpoint per sprint.
plots.life_zh: 新路由围绕它生长，一个迭代长一个端点。
plots.close_en: No big bang, just patient ivy.
plots.close_zh: 没有大爆炸，只有耐心的常春藤。

plots.open_en: The platform team paves a golden path from repo to production.
plots.open_zh: 平台团队铺了一条从仓库到生产的黄金大道。
plots.life_en: One command scaffolds a service with dashboards and alarms included.
plots.life_zh: 一条命令生成服务，自带看板和告警。
plots.close_en: The paved road won because it is genuinely nicer.
plots.close_zh: 铺好的路赢了，因为它真的好走。

plots.open_en: We design team boundaries before service boundaries.
plots.open_zh: 我们先设计团队边界再设计服务边界。
plots.life_en: One team owned too many rooms; we drew a gentler map.
plots.life_zh: 一个团队管了太多房间；我们画了一张更温柔的地图。
plots.close_en: Architecture is an org chart made of code.
plots.close_zh: 架构是用代码画成的组织架构图。

plots.open_en: Old and new systems run side by side for a month.
plots.open_zh: 新旧系统并行运行一个月。
plots.life_en: The diff tool catches one discrepancy and we celebrate catching it.
plots.life_zh: 差异工具抓到一处不一致，我们为抓到而庆祝。
plots.close_en: Confidence is measured in quiet diffs.
plots.close_zh: 信心是用安静的差异度量的。

plots.open_en: The platform team starts treating developers as customers.
plots.open_zh: 平台团队开始把开发者当客户。
plots.life_en: A golden path ships: new service to production in one afternoon.
plots.life_zh: 黄金路径上线：新服务一个下午就能上生产。
plots.close_en: The paved road won because it is genuinely nicer.
plots.close_zh: 铺好的路赢了，因为它真的好走。

plots.open_en: We design team boundaries around human memory limits.
plots.open_zh: 我们围绕人类记忆极限设计团队边界。
plots.life_en: One team owned too many rooms; we drew a gentler map.
plots.life_zh: 一个团队管了太多房间；我们画了一张更温柔的地图。
plots.close_en: Architecture is organizational chart made of code.
plots.close_zh: 架构是用代码画成的组织架构图。

plots.open_en: We want a clearer ownership line, so we rearrange teams first.
plots.open_zh: 我们想要更清晰的所有权线，所以先调整团队。
plots.life_en: The system boundary follows the team boundary, like water.
plots.life_zh: 系统边界跟着团队边界流动，像水一样。
plots.close_en: Change the people map; the code map follows.
plots.close_zh: 改人的地图，代码的地图跟上。

plots.open_en: Architecture rules become automated tests.
plots.open_zh: 架构规则变成自动化测试。
plots.life_en: A dependency sneaks across a boundary; the fitness function barks.
plots.life_zh: 一条依赖偷偷越界；适应度函数叫了起来。
plots.close_en: The map now defends itself.
plots.close_zh: 地图学会了自卫。

plots.open_en: A chaos drill floods the least protected zone, as designed.
plots.open_zh: 混沌演习淹没了防护最弱的区，一切按剧本。
plots.life_en: The recovery took nineteen minutes and taught us where the water enters.
plots.life_zh: 恢复花了十九分钟，并告诉我们水从哪进。
plots.close_en: Every drill buys one dry basement.
plots.close_zh: 每次演习都换一间干燥的地下室。

plots.open_en: Decision archaeology afternoon: why does the retry layer exist?
plots.open_zh: 决策考古的下午：重试层为什么存在？
plots.life_en: An old incident explains the mystery; the design was once heroic.
plots.life_zh: 一桩旧事故解开了谜团；那设计曾经很英勇。
plots.close_en: We keep the layer and finally its story too.
plots.close_zh: 我们留下了那一层，也终于留下了它的故事。

plots.open_en: Cutover day runs like a well chaired meeting.
plots.open_zh: 切换日像一场主持得当的会议。
plots.life_en: Go signals, rollback criteria, and one calm voice on the bridge.
plots.life_zh: 放行信号、回滚标准，和桥上一颗平静的声音。
plots.close_en: The migration finished before lunch, politely.
plots.close_zh: 迁移在午饭前礼貌地完成了。

plots.open_en: We overload staging until it complains politely.
plots.open_zh: 我们把预发布压到礼貌地抱怨。
plots.life_en: Load shedding sheds the right things; the demo still works degraded.
plots.life_zh: 限流丢掉了该丢的；演示以降级模式照常进行。
plots.close_en: Guests notice fewer lights, not a dark house.
plots.close_zh: 客人只注意到灯少了些，而不是一片黑。

plots.open_en: Every architecture proposal now ships with a monthly bill.
plots.open_zh: 每份架构提案现在都自带月账单。
plots.life_en: The fancy option costs five times more per smile.
plots.life_zh: 华丽方案每个微笑贵五倍。
plots.close_en: We picked the boring architecture and a beach vacation fund.
plots.close_zh: 我们选了朴实的架构，和一个度假基金。

plots.open_en: Threat modeling joins the blueprint stage, not the postmortem stage.
plots.open_zh: 威胁建模进入蓝图阶段，而不是事后复盘阶段。
plots.life_en: Boundaries, badges, and bollards appear in the first drawing.
plots.life_zh: 边界、门禁、护栏出现在第一版图纸上。
plots.close_en: The cheapest security is drawn early.
plots.close_zh: 最便宜的安全是画在最早的。

plots.open_en: This quarter's architecture award goes to a deletion.
plots.open_zh: 本季架构奖颁给了一次删除。
plots.life_en: Removing an unused cache tier made everything faster and clearer.
plots.life_zh: 移除一个没人用的缓存层让一切更快更清楚。
plots.close_en: The best code review comment was delete.
plots.close_zh: 最好的评审意见是：删掉。

plots.open_en: New hires get an architecture story hour, scars included.
plots.open_zh: 新人参加架构故事会，伤疤也在内。
plots.life_en: They quiz through the map before their first ticket.
plots.life_zh: 领第一张工单前，他们要通过地图问答。
plots.close_en: New eyes find the missing legend.
plots.close_zh: 新眼睛找到了缺失的图例。

plots.open_en: Leo writes an ADR arguing against his own favorite tool.
plots.open_zh: Leo 写了一篇反对自己心爱工具的决策记录。
plots.life_en: The honest trade-off table convinces the room, including him.
plots.life_zh: 诚实的取舍表说服了全场，包括他自己。
plots.close_en: Intellectual honesty is an architectural feature.
plots.close_zh: 智识上的诚实是一种架构特性。

plots.open_en: The year's biggest traffic day arrives; the new architecture yawns.
plots.open_zh: 全年最大流量日到来；新架构打了个哈欠。
plots.life_en: Regions balance, queues breathe, and the war room orders dessert.
plots.life_zh: 区域均衡、队列呼吸，作战室点了甜点。
plots.close_en: We watched the dashboards the way you watch a campfire.
plots.close_zh: 我们看着仪表盘，像看一堆篝火。

plots.open_en: Day three hundred thirty: the debt ledger and the architecture map finally agree.
plots.open_zh: 第三百三十天：债务台账与架构地图终于对齐。
plots.life_en: Maria asks what I learned drawing maps all quarter.
plots.life_zh: Maria 问，画了一季度地图学到了什么。
plots.close_en: "Every wall is a promise," I say. "Draw only the ones you can keep."
plots.close_zh: “每一堵墙都是承诺，”我说，“只画你守得住的。”
